raw_value_note: Values are the stored CHELSA raster-unit values. Positive affine scale/offset conversion does not change the mathematical quantile partition. BIO12 raw maximum is 65535 for CPI; no ad hoc deletion or substitution was applied. This audit checks the frozen extraction, not pixel-level validity or raster metadata.
method: Downloaded the exact Actions ZIP into the working environment, verified its SHA256 against GitHub metadata, independently read the CSV, collapsed species-repeated regional vectors, checked conflicts and compared coverage with the frozen WGSRPD1 lookup.
limitation: This is not a re-extraction of original raster pixels. Climate matching uses two regional median variables and coarse quantile classes; seasonality, within-region climate variation and full climatic equivalence are not controlled.
